items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: An old friend. A great trumpet player... He recorded a couple of things that I composed and a really good friend.

ctx.x: That, yes. They’ve got their own thing, the Latin music. I’m a little more, one of the bands that I don’t know whether it fits in this category but that I loved was Earth, Wind and Fire and Sly and the Family Stone. But as far as that being in Florida, they do play Latin music. It’s not completely authentic because there are a lot of pop touches in it, but they are a really good band.
I’d like to run a couple of names by you and see if you have anything that you might offer. Lew Soloff? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

An old friend. A great trumpet player, really great trumpet player. He recorded a couple of things that I composed and a really good friend. We’ve known each other — as a matter of fact I met him that second year that I played up in the Catskills, he was in the American band. Yeah. Really nice guy. Kind-hearted fellow, and like I said, a hell of a trumpet player.
